subject: CPAN board baselines have drifted since s322 — 7 rows, incl. Role-Tiny extend-role-tiny.t PASS→FAIL ("Package Role::Tiny does not exist")
description:
USER-RULED s376: **bless docs/cpan-board14-s376.tsv as the board baseline, but
only AFTER a per-file audit** — same discipline as #223's sweep pass-baseline,
never a blanket refresh (that absorbs a loss silently).  Then close this task
and the board has a real regression gate again.

THE FRESH RUN IS ALREADY TAKEN: `docs/cpan-board14-s376.tsv`, the whole
14-dist board at commit beb4187 / gen v2-126 — **2053 ok / 483 not-ok, 70 PASS
/ 64 PARTIAL / 49 FAIL of 183**, vs s343's 1794 / 674 and 65/65/53.  Command:

  tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl --jobs 8 --tsv docs/cpan-board14-s376.tsv \
    Algorithm-Diff-1.201-0 Capture-Tiny-0.50-0 Class-Inspector-1.36-0 \
    Class-Method-Modifiers-2.15-0 Data-Dump-1.25-0 File-Which-1.27-0 \
    Mojo-DOM58-3.002-0 Role-Tiny-2.002004-0 Safe-Isa-1.000010-0 \
    Sort-Versions-1.62-0 Sub-Uplevel-0.2800-0 Text-Balanced-2.07-0 \
    Try-Tiny-0.32-0 --no-dist-lib Scalar-List-Utils-1.70-0
(run from ~/.cpan/build; --no-dist-lib applies to every dist AFTER the flag,
so Scalar-List-Utils must come last.)

THE AUDIT, per file that moved s343 -> s376:
 - a row-count RISE is coverage, not a regression — read ROWS, never the
   PASS/PARTIAL label (a file that runs further and then fails a new row goes
   PASS -> PARTIAL while gaining passes).
 - a row-count FALL is the thing to explain before blessing.  The one known
   LOSS from the older four-dist compare is still open below.
 - `--no-dist-lib` files (all 38 Scalar-List-Utils) moved a lot this session
   by design (#238 first pass, 319/120 -> 398/75) — expected, not drift.

STILL OPEN, the one real loss, unchanged since s330 and re-measured s342c:
 - Role-Tiny extend-role-tiny.t  PASS 1/0 -> FAIL 0/0.  CAUSE taken live: it
   dies at LOAD with an SBCL reader error `Package Role::Tiny does not exist`
   at the generated file's line 83 — a package referenced before its
   p-defpackage exists (BEGIN-block package + `use Role::Tiny ()` + @ISA in
   the same BEGIN).  Diagnose this BEFORE blessing, or bless with the row
   edited in by hand carrying its cause (the fail-baseline convention).

NOTE (s342c, may now be stale): 8 of the 9 Try-Tiny/S-L-U board files that
transuled through v1 were the #26 block-form-capture gate — v1 is GONE since
E4.1, so re-check whether that note still applies before using it.

RELATED, likely to move these numbers again first: #239 (an in-block
`package X;` leaves globals in the enclosing package) hits NINE
Class-Method-Modifiers t-files and Role-Tiny's method-conflicts.t, and is the
next Opus item.  Consider auditing AFTER #239 lands so the bless is taken on
a board that already has it.
